name: Koala Conservation Centre
note: tree-top boardwalks to see wild koalas in the eucalypts, run by Phillip Island Nature Parks.

name: Churchill Island
note: 57-hectare island reached by causeway, with a heritage farm and a farmers' market.

name: Cape Woolamai
note: cape with walking loops among shearwater burrows and a surf beach at the island's south-east.

name: Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit
note: purpose-built 1950s circuit hosting the MotoGP Australian Grand Prix, open to visitors on non-event days through track tours.

name: National Vietnam Veterans Museum
note: volunteer-run museum of Vietnam War memorabilia at Cape Woolamai, with over 5,000 items.

name: Rhyll Inlet and Conservation Hill
note: inlet and wetlands at Rhyll, a feeding and breeding area for birds, with a boardwalk pathway.

name: Phillip Island Chocolate Factory
note: commercial factory with a paid interactive chocolate attraction (Panny's Amazing World of Chocolate) at Newhaven.

name: A Maze'N Things
note: maze, mini-golf, illusions hall and adventure ropes course at Phillip Island Road.

name: French Island
note: Western Port island with national park, koalas and waterbirds, reached by passenger ferry from Stony Point or Cowes.

name: State Coal Mine
note: former coal mine museum at Wonthaggi, run by Parks Victoria, with underground tours.

name: Lock 11
note: Murray lock and weir with Lock Island walking tracks and sandbars, where paddle steamers lock through at Mildura.

name: Meeting of the Waters
note: Riverside park viewpoint at Wentworth where the Murray and Darling rivers meet, about 20 km west of Mildura.

name: Australian Inland Botanic Gardens
note: Semi-arid botanic gardens at Buronga, near Mildura, with plants from every inhabited continent and native species.

name: Apex Park
note: Riverside park on the Murray at Mildura with a sandbar swimming beach, sometimes patrolled.

name: Port of Echuca
note: Historic 1800s river port with its wharf, paddle steamer boarding and the Discovery Centre at Echuca.

name: Barmah National Park
note: River red gum forest on the Murray floodplain with Barmah Lakes, birdwatching, paddling, fishing and camping.

name: Dharnya Centre
note: Yorta Yorta cultural and environmental interpretation centre inside Barmah National Park.

name: Kyabram Fauna Park
note: Goulburn Valley wildlife park at Kyabram with native animals.

name: Terrick Terrick National Park
note: Small box-ironbark park near Pyramid Hill, with walking tracks and camping.

name: Murray-Sunset National Park
note: Victoria's largest national park, remote mallee country for 4WD, birdwatching, camping and stargazing.

name: Pink Lakes
note: Pink-hued salt lakes inside Murray-Sunset National Park, a favourite with photographers.

name: Hattah-Kulkyne National Park
note: Chain of Murray lakes, river red gums and bush tracks with camping, near Mildura.

name: Wyperfeld National Park
note: Victoria's first national park, mallee bushland with walks and camping, reached from Hopetoun.

name: Lake Tyrrell
note: Intermittent salt lake near Sea Lake with a mirror-like surface that draws photographers.

name: Gunbower National Park
note: River red gum forest on the Murray with bend camping areas for four wheel driving and camping.

name: Pioneer Settlement
note: Living history museum of 1850s cottages, horse-drawn carriages and a river cruise on the Murray at Swan Hill.

name: Swan Hill River Walk
note: 4.5 km riverside walk along the Murray from the Pump Station past the town's attractions.

name: Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum
note: Restored Catalina flying boat and wartime exhibits at the former RAAF depot, 16 km from Swan Hill.

name: Shepparton Art Museum
note: Regional gallery in Shepparton with Australian and contemporary art.

name: KidsTown
note: Children's adventure playground between Shepparton and Mooroopna, entry by donation.

name: Rutherglen Loops
note: 48 km of linked cycling trails joining Rutherglen cellar doors, the Murray and Lake Moodemere.

name: Lake Mulwala
note: Murray reservoir at Yarrawonga and Mulwala used for boating, water sports and fishing.

name: Coombe Yarra Valley Melba's Garden Walk
Donna Buang Rainforest Gallery and Skywalk
